units.source_text: 另外据这位山村姑娘说，她是孪生儿。

en.t: Besides, according to this mountain village girl, she was a twin.

units.source_text: 那么，难道这位亲生父亲在杉树梢上还牵挂着被遗弃的双生儿千重子，才不慎摔下来的？

en.t: Then could it be that her birth father, still thinking of Chieko, the abandoned twin, up in the top of the cedar tree, had slipped and fallen?
Surely that must have been how it happened.
